stories.title: Real estate Q2 sees mixed results as luxury projects drive growth
stories.summary: India's top developers reported mixed pre-sales in Q2FY27, with some firms hindered by approval and launch delays. Others saw significant growth, particularly through luxury projects like Oberoi Realty's 360 North. The market is consolidating as larger players gain dominance. Success now depends on the project segment.

stories.title: BSE Realty index hits 52-week high
stories.summary: The BSE Realty index rose 17 percent in November, reaching a 52-week high of 7,401.10. Stocks including Godrej Properties and Prestige Estates rallied on expectations of improved demand in the second half of the financial year. The index is currently at its highest level since November 2025.

stories.title: Aditya Birla Real Estate targets 15,000 crore annual pre-sales
stories.summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate aims for 15,000 crore in annual pre-sales within three years. The company recorded over 8,000 crore in bookings during the past two financial years. Management cites strong housing demand for branded players across major cities as the primary driver for this growth target.

stories.title: From entire towers to entire floors, Mumbai investors drive big-ticket property deals
stories.summary: Vandana Ramnani leads the real estate vertical at Hindustan Times Digital, bringing over two decades of journalism experience across real estate, education, human resources, and foreign affairs. She specialises in India’s real estate sector, covering residential and commercial markets in Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, and Bengaluru, with in-depth reporting on regulatory developments,

stories.title: Mumbai luxury property deals total 399 crore
stories.summary: Two high-value transactions involving Lodha developments in Mumbai have reached 399 crore. Investor Mukul Agrawal purchased office space for 163 crore, while Gufic Private Limited bought a luxury duplex for 236 crore. Luxury real estate remains a primary focus for high-value transactions in the city.

stories.title: Lodha Group faces 4,000 crore family dispute alongside sales targets
stories.summary: Macrotech Developers, formerly Lodha Group, is targeting 24,000 crore in sales for FY27. The company reported a 10 percent increase in September quarter bookings, reaching 5,037 crore. This growth occurs alongside ongoing ED investigations and a 4,000 crore family dispute currently before the Bombay High Court.

RERA registers over 1.6 lakh projects by mid-2026
stories.summary: India's real estate sector has increased digital transparency, with 1.61 lakh projects and 1.13 lakh agents registered under RERA by mid-2026. The Reserve Bank of India also issued new project finance directions in 2025 to strengthen monitoring and risk management. Public project information is now a regulatory standard.

stories.title: Knight Frank forecasts 18.1 percent rental growth by 2031
stories.summary: Knight Frank expects rental growth to reach 18.1 percent by 2031. Recent tax increases on rental income, combined with existing mortgage interest restrictions and energy efficiency standards, continue to constrain supply. The firm revised its prime central London forecast downward to 11.5 percent from 16.5 percent.

stories.title: British rental costs expected to outpace house prices
stories.summary: Research from Hamptons suggests rental costs in Britain will rise twice as fast as house prices until at least 2029. Rents on new lets are forecast to grow 14.2 percent compared to 7.2 percent for house prices. Landlords face higher costs and tighter regulations, further limiting supply.

stories.title: Supply shortages drive rental growth
stories.summary: Hamptons forecasts a 14.2 percent rise in rents on new lets between 2026 and 2029, doubling the expected 7.2 percent increase in house prices. The firm identifies supply as the central challenge facing the rental market, as regulatory and financial hurdles continue to limit available housing stock.

stories.title: Rental price growth projected to double house price gains
stories.summary: Hamptons expects private rents on newly-let properties to increase by 14.2 percent between late 2026 and late 2029. Over the same period, house prices are forecast to rise by 7.2 percent. Competition between tenants is cited as the primary factor keeping rental growth ahead of purchase prices.

stories.title: Haryana introduces seven-day building plan approval
stories.summary: Haryana has implemented a seven-day check for building plans on plotted properties to accelerate construction. The move aims to streamline the approval process in one of India's fastest-growing urban regions. The state continues to manage high demand for infrastructure and housing across its major districts.

stories.title: Residential building tilts in Gurugram Sector 52
stories.summary: A four-storey residential building in Gurugram Sector 52 has begun to tilt, causing concern among local residents. The incident highlights ongoing issues with structural safety and urban development in the region. Authorities have not yet provided a final assessment on the building's stability or cause.

stories.title: Supreme Court orders registry for 7,802 Noida flats
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has directed the Noida Authority to permit the registration of 7,802 apartments in the Sports City projects. Homebuyers have waited years for this relief, which was previously blocked by developer dues and layout plan disputes. This marks a shift in the local regulatory deadlock.

stories.title: First Sports City registries approved by Supreme Court
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has ordered the registration of 7,802 flats at Lotus Greens’ Sports City in Sector 150. This is the first time any of the city's four Sports City projects will allow flat registries. The court ruled against a condition requiring a lien on 20 percent of units.

stories.title: Mumbai businesses move into flexible offices
stories.summary: Mumbai is seeing a shift in commercial real estate as corporations, startups and independent consultants increasingly adopt flexible workspace arrangements. Coworking providers are positioning themselves as a core component of the city's office landscape, offering modern infrastructure and professionally managed environments to replace traditional long-term leasing models.

stories.title: Hyderabad sees growth in flexible office demand
stories.summary: Hyderabad is experiencing rising demand for flexible office spaces as the city expands its technology and innovation sectors. Coworking operators are marketing their facilities as a primary alternative to traditional leasing, citing the need for modern amenities and collaborative environments in a rapidly growing business ecosystem.

stories.title: Chennai adopts flexible workspace models
stories.summary: Chennai is diversifying its business ecosystem, with firms ranging from IT companies to independent professionals moving toward flexible working arrangements. Coworking spaces are being integrated into the city's commercial real estate market to provide managed workplaces, aiming to offer businesses an alternative to traditional office infrastructure.

stories.title: India coworking market shifts toward flexible models
stories.summary: The Indian commercial real estate market is increasingly moving away from traditional long-term office leases. Coworking providers are scaling their operations to offer flexible, modern infrastructure for a range of businesses, as hybrid work arrangements become a standard feature of the national workplace landscape.

stories.title: Bangalore office market embraces flexible solutions
stories.summary: Bangalore is seeing a transformation in office infrastructure as traditional leases are increasingly supplemented by flexible workspace solutions. The city's technology and startup sectors are driving demand for scalable, modern amenities, with coworking providers positioning themselves to support a growing population of independent professionals and corporations.

stories.title: Delhi NCR expands flexible workspace ecosystem
stories.summary: Delhi NCR has developed a broad network of coworking spaces across New Delhi, Gurugram and Noida. The region is catering to startups and enterprises by offering managed office environments, aiming to align with the growing preference for hybrid work and professional networking opportunities in major commercial hubs.

stories.title: Bengaluru office leasing led by global centers
stories.summary: Global Capability Centres accounted for 65 percent of office leasing in Bengaluru as demand from technology firms shifts. Developers continue to build large office parks, with 36.1 million sq ft currently in the pipeline. Location strategy is now prioritising commute efficiency and long-term cost competitiveness.

stories.title: India office furniture market to hit $7.78 billion
stories.summary: The Indian office furniture market is projected to grow to $7.78 billion by 2031, up from $4.81 billion in 2025. Growth is attributed to commercial leasing and workplace modernisation, with Global Capability Centres responsible for 42 percent of total office absorption in the first nine months of 2026.

stories.title: India's Retail Infrastructure Needs to Keep Pace with 43.7 Million Sq. Ft. of New Supply | The Realty Today
stories.summary: India is set to add 43.7 million sq. ft. of retail space by 2030, raising questions about connectivity, urban infrastructure and market readiness. India's organised retail market is preparing for a sizable addition of space. JLL estimates that nearly 43.7 million sq. ft. of new retail space will be delivered

(ALLHC), a subsidiary of Ayala Land, and Singapore-based FLOW Digital Infrastructure in their A-FLOW joint venture in Biñan. The proposed takeover highlights a shift in investment priorities,

stories.title: How the Data Center Boom Is Reshaping Industrial Supply Chains
stories.summary: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and digital services is creating a new wave of infrastructure investment. Technology companies are building facilities that can support increasingly demanding computing workloads, while businesses across multiple industries are responding to the resulting demand. Much of the attention surrounding this expansion focuses

stories.title: Nebius India Data Centers
stories.summary: Nebius plans to open its first two Asia-Pacific data centers in India in 2027. In this article The first Indian site could be running customer workloads in the first half of 2027. For that to happen, a partner would need to hand over a hall with power and cooling early

Transportation drives industrial value
stories.summary: Transportation and packaging can sometimes account for up to 50 percent of the cost of goods sold. As of Nov. 9, U.S. diesel prices averaged $6.13 per gallon nationally and nearly $7.90 in California, according to the U.S. Energy Information Administration, increasing the appeal of warehouses near major transportation corridors.

stories.title: Chennai plans airport corridor upgrade
stories.summary: The Greater Chennai Corporation has announced a Rs 120 million project to redevelop the 5.8-km corridor between the airport and Kathipara flyover. The Gateway of Chennai project will add themed public spaces and pedestrian pathways, with the design intended to reflect the city's coastal character.

stories.title: Surat-Bilimora rail section energised
stories.summary: The Overhead Equipment system is now energised on the 50 km Surat-Bilimora section of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail Corridor. The project includes bridges across four rivers and a steel bridge over National Highway 53. Testing activities for the high-speed rail project are expected to follow.

stories.title: Surat-Bilimora bullet train section electrified
stories.summary: The Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train project has energised the Overhead Equipment system on the 50-km Surat-Bilimora section. The corridor uses a 2 x 25 kV overhead traction system designed for high-speed operations. Electrification will continue across smaller sections to ensure compliance and safety.

stories.title: Delhi to build multi-level parking in Rani Bagh
stories.summary: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi plans to build a 600-car parking facility at Rani Bagh’s Sant Nagar under a public-private partnership. The civic body expects the project to address local parking woes while saving an estimated 96.87 crore rupees in construction expenditure.

stories.title: Surat-Vapi bullet train section planned for 2027
stories.summary: India’s first bullet train service is expected to begin in the last quarter of 2027. The Surat-Vapi section of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor is planned to open ahead of the rest of the route. The project aims to reduce travel time between the two cities to two hours.

stories.title: Gurugram metro phase two land acquisition begins
stories.summary: The Gurugram Land Purchase Committee has issued a notice to acquire 2,529.71 square metres of private land for the second phase of the Millennium City Centre-Cyber City metro corridor. The land is located in Gurugram, Dundahera, and Carterpuri villages.

stories.title: Nashik Phata-Khed corridor construction to start
stories.summary: The National Highways Authority of India has completed land acquisition for the Nashik Phata-Khed elevated corridor. Construction of the eight-lane highway project is expected to begin within two months. The corridor is intended to ease traffic congestion along the Pune-Nashik highway.

stories.title: PM launches 34,000 crore rupees in Bihar projects
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has inaugurated 227 infrastructure projects in Bihar, including the Nitish Setu bridge and various national highway sections. The launch also included the second unit of the Buxar Thermal Power Project. The total value of the projects is approximately 34,000 crore rupees.

stories.title: MahaRERA reduces conciliation period
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Real Estate Regulatory Authority has halved the conciliation period for disputes between homebuyers and developers from 60 days to 30 days. The change aims to speed up the resolution process for property-related grievances within the state.

stories.title: TGRERA orders plot registration for BHEL employees
stories.summary: The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority has ordered the registration of plots for 38 employees of the BHEL Housing Society in Indresham. The order addresses a disparity where 125 members had already obtained registered plots while the remaining group was left waiting.

stories.title: Delhi High Court rules on vacancy allowance
stories.summary: The Delhi High Court dismissed an appeal by the Revenue department regarding DLF Ltd. The court upheld the deletion of an addition of over 3.28 crore rupees related to notional rent for properties that remained vacant. The decision follows previous judgments regarding real estate income classification.

stories.title: BHEL society members retain plot rights
stories.summary: The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority ruled that 38 members of the Elite BHEL Employees Housing Society are entitled to plot registration in the Magnus Elite Homes project. The authority rejected the promoter's attempt to cancel the allotments based on a 2022 deadline.

stories.title: Maharashtra introduces vertical property cards
stories.summary: The Maharashtra government has launched a Vertical Property Card scheme to provide individual flat and commercial unit owners with official recognition in land records. The system replaces a framework that previously only listed builders or housing societies as the owners of the plot.

stories.title: Supreme Court clarifies developer liability in joint projects
stories.summary: The Supreme Court issued a ruling on February 20, 2026, regarding liability in joint development projects. The judgment provides clarity on whether landowners or developers are responsible for compensating flat buyers when projects are delayed. The case involved Unishire Homes LLP.

stories.title: Insolvency rules updated for real estate projects
stories.summary: New amendments to the insolvency framework introduce a project-specific approach for real estate companies. The change allows for the resolution of stressed developments without affecting completed or viable projects held by the same corporate entity during the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process.

stories.title: JK Urbanscapes plans 965 crore rupee hospitality expansion
stories.summary: JK Urbanscapes Developers Limited is investing 965 crore rupees in six hotel projects across India. The company is developing 650 keys alongside real estate projects with a projected topline exceeding 4,400 crore rupees. Partners include Indian Hotels Company Limited and Minor Hotels.

stories.title: Supreme Court hears Ford India tax case
stories.summary: The Supreme Court issued notice on Ford India's challenge to a Madras High Court order regarding sales tax. The dispute concerns conditions attached to a state government notification that granted tax exemptions for goods used at the company's Maraimalai Nagar factory.

stories.title: Pakistan registers two new REIT schemes
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan has registered two new Real Estate Investment Trust schemes, bringing the national total to 31. The new schemes include a hybrid project in Islamabad that combines property development with rental income generation.

stories.title: SECP registers two new REIT schemes
stories.summary: Pakistan's REIT sector held assets worth Rs 275.85 billion as of September 30, 2026, according to the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. The regulator has registered two new schemes, ATM T Dev Series One and Imperium Tower, bringing the national total to 31 registered schemes.

stories.title: Motilal Oswal launches fund for office space
stories.summary: Motilal Oswal Alternates has launched a fund targeting a corpus of up to ₹3,000 crore to invest in Grade A commercial office developments. The India Assets Excellence Fund to I has a base target of ₹1,500 crore, with a green shoe option to raise an additional ₹1,500 crore.

stories.title: Embassy REIT reports record payout
stories.summary: Embassy Office Parks REIT declared a distribution of ₹7.07 per unit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, marking its highest-ever quarterly payout. The company reaffirmed its FY27 guidance, citing 1.5 million square feet of leasing activity and a stable leverage ratio of 30 percent.

stories.title: REITs show 15 percent annualised returns
stories.summary: Commercial real estate is emerging as an attractive investment opportunity, with office spaces and REITs offering steady rental income. Knight Frank India reports that REITs have delivered 14 to 15 percent annualised returns over the past five to six years, supported by strong demand from Global Capability Centres.

stories.title: SECP registers two new REIT schemes
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan registered two new Real Estate Investment Trust schemes, bringing the national total to 31. The sector now comprises 43 licensed management companies, with assets amounting to Rs 275.85 billion as of September 30, 2026. Seven schemes are currently listed on the exchange.

stories.title: SECP registers two new REIT schemes
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan has registered two new Real Estate Investment Trust schemes, ATMT Develop REIT Series I and Imperium Tower REIT Scheme. This brings the total number of registered schemes in the country to 31, managed by 43 licensed REIT management companies.

stories.title: Al Salem Holding and Bokra to launch real estate fund
stories.summary: Al Salem Holding and Bokra Holding are preparing to launch Salem Bokra, a real estate investment fund they describe as Egypt’s first to comply with Islamic Sharia principles. The fund targets assets worth more than EGP 25 billion, with subscriptions opening following Financial Regulatory Authority approval.

stories.title: Investor wins tax dispute over REIT dividends
stories.summary: An Ahmedabad investor successfully challenged an income tax notice after claiming Rs 49.64 lakh in dividend income from REITs and InvITs as tax-exempt. The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal ruled in the investor's favour after the assessing officer questioned the tax-free status of the business trust distributions.

stories.title: PropStream to be featured on public television
stories.summary: Real estate technology company PropStream will appear in an upcoming segment of All Access hosted by Andy Garcia. The documentary series explores how real estate professionals use integrated property data and AI-assisted analysis to identify opportunities and evaluate potential deals in the modern market.

stories.title: PropStream to appear in documentary series
stories.summary: PropStream will appear in a segment of All Access hosted by Andy Garcia, a documentary series distributed to public television stations. The feature explores how real estate professionals use AI and technology to search for properties and evaluate potential deals in the current market.

stories.title: Technology shifts in home buying and financing
stories.summary: Technology is reshaping the home buying and financing process as the industry moves into 2027. Lenders are increasingly using photo-based tracking for construction progress, aiming to replace the traditional reliance on paper documentation and long wait times for buyers and sellers.

stories.title: AI Helps Small Business Owners Catch Red Flags In Real Estate Deals - Forbes
Zillow listing uses AI to mask property condition
stories.summary: A Zillow listing for a home in Cheboygan, Michigan, features AI-generated images of a manicured craftsman-style house. The actual property is a ramshackle cabin with significant structural damage and debris, offered for $80,800. The digital renovation does not extend to the physical structure.

stories.title: TV revivals aim to reduce content uncertainty
stories.summary: Television networks are increasingly betting on legacy shows to combat the struggle of finding viewers for new intellectual properties. Industry experts note that while revivals involve higher production costs, they offer built-in audience equity that reduces uncertainty in a competitive media landscape.

stories.title: Nitin Gadkari uses gaming trend for infrastructure
stories.summary: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari used GTA VI-themed graphics to showcase India's infrastructure development, including expressway expansion and reduced travel times. The campaign compared current road networks to those present when GTA V launched 13 years ago to highlight national progress.

stories.title: GTA 6 hideout locations
stories.summary: Players in GTA 6 can locate hideouts belonging to The Final Chapter biker gang in the Leonida region. These locations contain unique weapons, including a semi-auto KVGA-12 shotgun found at the Iron Building Supply warehouse in western Ambrosia, which players can steal during the game.

stories.title: GTA 6 real estate mission guide
stories.summary: In the South Leonida Real Estate mission, the character Lucia receives a call from Mia regarding her real estate business. The mission objective requires the player to visit Mia's office to address issues with a house she is selling before locating Mia at the property.

stories.title: Signature Global bags 4-Star GRESB Rating - Construction Week India
Construction robotics moves from novelty to necessity
stories.summary: Construction robotics is shifting from novelty to necessity, according to industry reports. Despite the transition, chaotic sites, fragmented supply chains, and entrenched working practices continue to complicate the road to widespread adoption. Machines are currently capable of beating humans at table tennis, if not yet building houses.

stories.title: Signatureglobal achieves 97.8 GRESB score
stories.summary: Signatureglobal has attained a GRESB score of 97.8 out of 100, up from 84 last year. The company secured a 4-star rating and ranks 12th globally among its residential peers. It achieved a perfect score in the reporting category, which the company attributes to its comprehensive approach.

stories.title: Signature Global reaches 4-star GRESB rating
stories.summary: Signature Global recorded a GRESB score of 97.8, an improvement from its debut score of 84. The company ranked 12th globally among residential peers and achieved a 100 percent score in reporting. It also planted over 9,700 trees during the 2026 fiscal year to meet sustainability goals.

Shree Cement targets 100 MTPA capacity
stories.summary: Shree Cement plans to exceed 100 million tonnes per annum of production capacity within four years. Chairman Hari Mohan Bangur expects the company to reach 80 MTPA within two years. The firm is targeting annual growth of 9 to 10 percent, outpacing the industry average of 7 to 8 percent.

stories.title: Shree Cement plans 100 MTPA capacity expansion
stories.summary: Shree Cement plans to increase its production capacity from 75 million tonnes per annum to over 100 MTPA within four years. The expansion is linked to expected demand from infrastructure and housing sectors. The company is targeting annual growth of 9 to 10 percent, exceeding industry expectations.

stories.title: Shree Cement eyes 100 MTPA capacity by 2027
stories.summary: Shree Cement aims to exceed 100 million tonnes per annum in capacity within four years. The company is investing 7,000 crore in Andhra Pradesh and up to 4,000 crore in Gujarat and Meghalaya. It also plans to increase its ready-mix concrete plants from 40 to 68.

stories.title: Michigan community launches virtual power plant
stories.summary: Veridian at County Farm, a net-zero community in Ann Arbor, is hosting Michigan's first residential virtual power plant. The development shares solar and battery power with the local grid. The project aims to lower energy costs and improve reliability for residents living in the fossil-fuel-free town houses.

stories.title: Standard Chartered discusses Vietnam energy transition
stories.summary: Standard Chartered representatives met with Vietnamese government officials to discuss financing the energy transition. The bank exchanged memorandums of understanding with DaiDung Group and Stavian Group. Discussions focused on investment opportunities for the ASEAN Power Grid and the implementation of the Just Energy Transition Partnership.

stories.title: Vietnam shifts green energy focus to Beijing
stories.summary: Following the U.S. withdrawal from the Just Energy Transition Partnership in March 2025, Vietnam is seeking funding from Chinese financial and industrial partners. The climate pact previously faced bureaucratic delays and sluggish disbursements. Vietnam has found other means to secure funding for its green energy transition.

stories.title: Thermal insulation coating market enters expansion phase
stories.summary: The global thermal insulation coating market is entering a phase of sustained expansion as industries prioritize energy efficiency and carbon reduction. According to an IndexBox report, the market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement behavior and a regionally diversified supply architecture for specialized thin-film barrier coatings.

stories.title: Styrene acrylic emulsion polymers market sees steady demand
stories.summary: The global market for styrene acrylic emulsion polymers enters 2026 with broader demand fundamentals and a more diversified supply architecture. According to IndexBox, the market is a foundational component of the consumer goods value chain, with demand derived entirely from the health of downstream durable goods categories.

stories.title: Professional caulk gun market remains high-volume
stories.summary: The global professional caulk gun market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement behavior, according to IndexBox. The sector is characterized by intense price competition and significant private-label penetration, with demand bifurcated between price-sensitive professional trades and premium DIY users seeking specific product benefits for their renovation projects.

stories.title: Climate diplomacy faces challenges after COP31
stories.summary: The COP31 discussions in Turkey concluded without a political consensus, raising concerns about the reliability of international climate commitments. The failure follows weak outcomes at previous conferences, highlighting a need for change. Small, vulnerable countries continue to seek financial help for extreme weather and rising sea levels.

stories.title: Trump stalled shipping’s global climate deal. Can it be saved? - Euronews
Seoul housing market shows uneven price trends
stories.summary: Apartment prices in Seoul's southern districts of Gangnam and Seocho fell by 1.79 percent and 1.37 percent respectively in October. Prices in traditionally cheaper northern neighborhoods continued to rise. The data highlights a market where homeownership remains out of reach for many despite cooling prices in affluent areas.

stories.title: Korea property tax burden reaches 2.2 times OECD average
stories.summary: Property taxes in South Korea account for 2.2 times the OECD average, with acquisition and transfer taxes reaching 4.7 times the average. The Center for Free Enterprise claims the structure places an excessive burden on individuals. The tax system is currently undergoing a comparison for potential reform tasks.

stories.title: Seoul price to income ratio falls to 11.7
stories.summary: The price to income ratio for owner occupied households in Seoul dropped from 13.9 to 11.7 last year despite rising home prices. The figure compares median prices to median income at a specific moment. It does not measure the actual time required to purchase a home.

stories.title: London super prime property sales value drops by half
stories.summary: London saw 42 homes sell for over US$10m in the third quarter of 2026, down from 46 in the previous quarter. Total sales value fell from US$1.46bn to US$722m, a decline of more than 50 percent. The average transaction value also dropped from US$31.7m to US$17.2m.

stories.title: UK House-Price Forecast Cut With London Luxury Trailing the Pack - Bloomberg.com
Few homes in Greece meet buyer requirements
stories.summary: Only 3.7 percent of homes in Attica and 2.9 percent in Thessaloniki meet the criteria for a popular home. Newdeal defines these as two bedroom apartments built after 1985 on the second floor or higher. The data suggests a mismatch between available stock and buyer needs.

stories.title: Hanoi apartment prices overtake Ho Chi Minh City
stories.summary: Average primary apartment prices in Hanoi reached US$4,349 per square metre, surpassing Ho Chi Minh City at US$4,210. Hanoi prices rose 122.8 percent over three years. New supply remains skewed toward the high end, increasing pressure on buyers. The choice for homebuyers is now more difficult.

stories.title: South Koreans in their 30s owning luxury homes surge 70 percent
stories.summary: The number of South Koreans in their 30s owning homes worth over 1.2 billion won reached 18,000 last year. This 70 percent annual increase is the largest since 2016. The rise is attributed to Seoul home price gains and gifts from the parental generation.

stories.title: Portugal residential construction costs rise 7.5 percent
stories.summary: Residential construction costs in Portugal rose 7.5 percent annually in August. Labour costs increased by 8 percent while material prices rose 7.1 percent. The National Statistics Institute reported that the growth rate accelerated from the 6.5 percent increase recorded in July. Building a home is becoming expensive.
